comment: Anchor->target pairings (0.53.0; structural since 0.58.0). JsStructuralAnalyzer finds an 'anchor' (a piece of logic) and a concrete 'target' structurally linked to it, emitting ONE Lead (anchor -> target, try X). link=guard: the target is used inside the code the anchor guards (if-branch, &&/?: operand, wrapped call, enclosing object literal). link=argument: the target literal is passed into the anchor's call directly or via a same-scope variable. A target merely nearby becomes a per-file note. Token-stream structure, not an AST. Bounded regex (ReDoS). Reported non-sensitive.

pairs.name: Client-side authorization gate -> route
pairs.note: this route appears to be gated only in the browser -- request its backing API directly with a low-priv/no session to check server-side authorization

pairs.name: Embedded crypto key/IV -> value
pairs.note: a key/IV/secret is embedded next to client-side crypto -- extract it and decrypt or forge offline (e.g. CyberChef); client-side crypto is not a control
